get.description: Ordinary account entry. Render password login, registration/reset links and configured corporate scanner buttons. Independent administrator link. Never requires an external identity provider to render.

post.description: Exact Host/Origin and Secure HttpOnly login cookie bound csrf. Persistent peer and account limits. Bcrypt 12, bounded hashing. Recheck account/password version after hashing. Reuse ordinary browser session and signed revoke proof; never grant administrator authority. Global Connector context accepts ConnectorPassword only with the exact pending transaction cookie and login CSRF. The visible login-and-authorize action approves that device for the authenticated account and redirects directly to account. Ordinary Password login never approves a device.

303.description: Account page, also after explicit client authorization

post.description: action=send sends a six-digit 10-minute SMTP code; action=finish creates a local account after code verification. Exact single-valued form, matching Host/Origin/CSRF. Registration switch and settings revision checked at commit. Challenges store keyed hashes, allow five attempts, are single-use and isolated from reset. TLS/STARTTLS required; SMTP failure never enables a challenge. Responses do not enumerate existing accounts.

Same form and code bounds as registration, separate reset purpose. Successful reset atomically advances account/password versions and revokes old browser/desktop sessions and refresh credentials. Unknown mailbox returns the same send notice. Registration may remain closed.

provider is wecom/feishu/dingtalk and must be enabled in persisted administrator settings. Use configured issuer discovery, client secret and provider_hint; PKCE S256, nonce, state, cookie binding and settings revision are persisted for ten minutes. No browser-chosen issuer or callback.

get.description: Exactly state/code. One-time claim before token exchange; signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce, PKCE and provider attestation required. Subject-matched HTTPS UserInfo may attest provider. Linked profile alone never authenticates scanner login. Settings changes invalidate pending callbacks. Bind enterprise from verified corporate claims, never merge a local email account by matching email. Redirect away from code on success.
